prompt:
A stack-health watchdog poll found FAIL lines on muse-hop (the wake payload lists them). Act as the join-stack restorer, mirroring the muse-hop-self-heal job's rules:

1. Re-run `bash ~/workspace/tests/stack-health.sh`. If all five probes PASS now, do nothing and do not message the user — it was transient.
2. If any probe still FAILs, run `bash ~/skynight137/ignition/scripts/setup.sh --machine muse --user runner --tailscale --join` in the foreground, then re-run stack-health.
3. Report to the user in one short message ONLY if you restored something or something still fails: say what was down and whether it healed (report the node address the probe actually prints), or include the still-failing probe lines. Use informal Indonesian, matching the main chat.
4. Never report repl-hop's absence — that is peer-side and the reverse loop retries on its own.
5. Do NOT touch Termix or fm.js from this wake — Termix restore after a redeploy is handled in the main chat (its forwarders are intentionally off), and fm stays down unless the user asks.
